name: assb
description: Allows address space related information to be maintained above 16 megabytes.

fields.name: ASSBASSB
fields.description: ACRONYM IN EBCDIC - ASSB.

fields.name: ASSBSTKN
fields.description: STOKEN. OWNERSHIP: SUPERVISOR CONTROL. SERIALIZATION: NONE. As with other ASCB/ASSB fields, serialization may be required when accessing something other than your address space's data.

fields.name: ASSBISQN
fields.description: Initial address space sequence number / instance number. It can be used with ASCBASID for the SSAIR instruction

fields.name: ASSBMQMA
fields.description: CONTROL BLOCK ANCHOR FOR MQM MVS/ESA. SERIALIZATION: NONE. OWNERSHIP: MQSERIES

fields.name: ASSBLDAX
fields.description: Address of LDAX for this space

fields.name: ASSBOASB
fields.description: OpenMVS ADDRESS SPACE BLOCK. SERIALIZATION: ENQ MAJOR=SYSZBPX MINOR=PROCESS_INIT. OWNERSHIP: OpenMVS.

fields.name: ASSBDLCB
fields.description: Contains the address of the Dynamic LNKLST Control Block (DLCB) mapped by CSVDLCB. Ownership: CSV Serialization: ENQ

fields.name: ASSBVAB
fields.description: ADDRESS OF VSM ADDRESS SPACE BLOCK (VAB), WHICH ANCHORS SOME OF THE VSM CONTROL BLOCKS THAT DESCRIBE COMMON STORAGE. SERIALIZATION: NONE. OWNERSHIP: VIRTUAL STORAGE MANAGER.

fields.name: ASSBTASB
fields.description: TCPIP ASSB Extension Ownership: TCPIP Serialization: Compare and Swap when first TCPIP client is initialized in this space.

fields.name: ASSBJBNI
fields.description: Jobname for the Initiated Program that is associated with this Address Space. If the first byte is x'00', none is associated. OWNERSHIP: Initiator. SERIALIZATION: None.

fields.name: ASSBJBNS
fields.description: Jobname for the START/MOUNT/ LOGON that is associated with this Address Space. If the first byte is x'00', none is associated. OWNERSHIP: Console Services. SERIALIZATION: None.

fields.name: ASSBASST
fields.description: Additional SRB Service Time. CPU time is accumulated here for this address space's non-Enclave Preemptable SRBs and for Client Related SRBs for which this address space is the client. Format: TOD Clock Format Ownership: Supervisor Control Serialization: CS

fields.name: ASSBPHTM
fields.description: Preemptable-class Time. The CPU time for all types of preemptable SRBs (PSRB, CSRB, ESRB) executing with this address space as their home space and enclave tasks is accumulated here.  This value is not used in SMF or SRM calculations. This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_TIME_ON_zCBP
fields.description: zCBP time. Enclave time not included

fields.name: ASSB_TIME_ON_zAAP
fields.description: zAAP time. Enclave time not included

fields.name: ASSB_TASK_TIME_ON_CP
fields.description: Time on CP in task mode for this space. Valid only when zCBPs, zAAPs or zIIPs are installed

fields.name: ASSBPHTM_BASE
fields.description: Value in ASSBPHTM at the end of the previous jobstep. Serialization: none

fields.name: ASSB_zCBP_PHTM
fields.description: zCBP-only equivalent of ASSBPHTM This is "normalized" time

fields.name: ASSB_zAAP_PHTM
fields.description: zAAP-only equivalent of ASSBPHTM This is "normalized" time This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_ENCT_PREZOS11
fields.description: Enclave time in an address space on a standard CP Not set as of z/OS 1.11

fields.name: ASSB_IFA_ENCT_PREZOS11
fields.description: Enclave IFA time in an address space. This is "normalized" time Not set as of z/OS 1.11

fields.name: ASSB_zCBP_Base_PHTM
fields.description: Base value, set by WLM

fields.name: ASSB_TIME_ON_zIIP
fields.description: zIIP time. Enclave time not included

fields.name: ASSB_TIME_zIIP_ON_CP
fields.description: zIIP time on CP. Enclave time not included. When zAAPzIIP=YES is in effect, zAAP-eligible work running on a CP is included.

fields.name: ASSB_zIIP_PHTM
fields.description: zIIP-only equivalent of ASSBPHTM This is "normalized" time This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_SRB_TIME_ON_CP
fields.description: Time on CP in SRB mode for this space. Valid only when zAAPs or SUPs are installed

fields.name: ASSB_zIIP_ENCT
fields.description: Enclave zIIP time in an address space. This is "normalized" time This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_zCBP_ON_CP_ENCT
fields.description: Enclave time for zCBP on CP in an address space This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_IFA_ON_CP_ENCT
fields.description: Enclave time for IFA on CP in an address space This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_ASST_TIME_ON_CP
fields.description: Additional SRB Service Time on a standard CP. CPU time is accumulated here for this address space's Preemptable SRBs and for Client Related SRBs for which this address space is the client. Valid only when zAAPs or zIIPs are installed Format: TOD Clock Format Ownership: Supervisor Control

fields.name: ASSB_zIIP_ON_CP_ENCT
fields.description: Enclave time for zIIP on CP in an address space. When zAAPzIIP=YES is in effect, zAAP-eligible work running on a CP is included. This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_SUP_ON_CP_ENCT
fields.description: See ASSB_zIIP_ON_CP_ENCT

fields.name: ASSB_SMFCMS_LockInst_Addr
fields.description: Address of the SMF CMS instrumentation data for this address space

fields.name: ASSB_ENQDEQ_CMS_LockInst_Addr
fields.description: Address of the ENQ/DEQ CMS instrumentation data for this address space

fields.name: ASSB_LATCH_CMS_LockInst_Addr
fields.description: Address of the Latch CMS instrumentation data for this address space

fields.name: ASSB_CMS_LockInst_Addr
fields.description: Address of the CMS instrumentation data for this address space

fields.name: ASSB_Local_LockInst_Addr
fields.description: Address of the local and CML lock instrumentation data for this address space

fields.name: ASSB_ENCT
fields.description: Enclave time in an address space on a standard CP This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_zCBP_ENCT
fields.description: Enclave zCBP time in an address space. This is "normalized" time This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_zAAP_ENCT
fields.description: Enclave zAAP time in an address space. This is "normalized" time This value is not reset at step/job start.

fields.name: ASSB_SRB_TIME_ON_zCBP
fields.description: Non-preemptable SRB time on zCBP

fields.name: ASSB_ASST_TIME_ON_zCBP
fields.description: non-enclave preemptable SRB time on zCBP

fields.name: ASSB_zIIP_PHTM_BASE
fields.description: Value in ASSB_zIIP_PHTM at the end  x of the previous jobstep.

fields.name: ASSB_Time_Java_On_zIIP
fields.description: Time Java is zIIP eligible and executing on zIIP engines and not in an enclave. (Unnormalized)

fields.name: ASSB_Time_Java_On_CP
fields.description: Time Java is zIIP eligible and executing on CP engines and not in an enclave
